snippet.title: Wild Assault Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Wild Assault Early Access is now available on Steam and Epic Games Store!
Find out more: https://bit.ly/wildassault
Official Website: https://www.wildassault.com

Discover your feral ego, #FollowYourInstincts, fight alongside fellow Valiants, and unleash your raw fury!
Calling all Wild Ones: Operation Mojave is a go. We repeat, Operation Mojave is a go!
————————————————————————————————————————
😼 Wild Assault is an Anthro Tactical Shooter developed with Unreal Engine 5! 
Check it out on Steam:
https://bit.ly/wildassault
🐰 Follow us on social media!
https://www.facebook.com/WildAssault
https://twitter.com/WildAssaultGame
🐯 Join in our Discord server!
https://discord.gg/wildassault
